old_caption: The video captures a rocky stream flowing through a natural landscape. The water cascades over smooth, rounded stones and boulders, creating a turbulent, churning motion with white foam. The rocks vary in size and shape, some large and imposing, others smaller and scattered along the streambed. The water appears clear, revealing the pebbles beneath its surface. Vegetation, including small plants and moss, clings to the rocks, adding a touch of green to the otherwise muted tones of the scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the dynamic interplay between the water and the rocks.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene scene of a rocky stream flowing through a natural landscape. The water cascades over smooth, rounded stones and boulders, creating a gentle, soothing sound. The rocks vary in size and shape, some large and imposing, others smaller and scattered along the streambed. The water appears clear, revealing the pebbles beneath its surface. Vegetation, including small plants and moss, clings to the rocks, adding a touch of green to the otherwise muted tones of the scene. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, with the continuous flow of water providing a calming backdrop. There are no visible animals or human characters in the video, allowing the viewer to fully immerse themselves in the natural beauty of the setting. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the dynamic interplay between the water and the rocks, emphasizing the peacefulness of the environment.
caption: The video captures a fixed, low-angle view of a rocky mountain stream, where clear water rushes continuously toward the lower right. In the upper-left background, a small white waterfall spills a steady sheet of falling water onto a sloping rock face. Large grey boulders line both banks, and a mossy foreground rock on the left carries a few green leafy sprouts. A thin bare twig rests diagonally across a flat stone in the lower-center foreground, staying anchored in the same pose throughout. The main visible process is the churning flow. A patch of white aerated foam in the mid-right of the frame continuously deforms, expands and contracts, and drifts downstream, its shape differing from moment to moment. This turbulence is already in motion at the first frame and still in motion at the last, with no onset or completion visible within the excerpt. The camera holds still, so the rocks, sprouts, and resting twig never shift, leaving the moving water as the only active element.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
